scenes.setting: Jack's mouth splits to his ears and he lunges at Joshua — stopped by an invisible wall while the Demon Hunter's swords and dawn-light afterimages evaporate him; then Derrick jolts awake at a campfire, the whole thing a dream before the city and the temple they have yet to reach
scenes.text_anchor: “We will set off after 50 rounds of lightning.”

scenes.setting: After a hot bath, one divination above the fog: the pendulum whirls clockwise — the sealed evil spirit's malice toward him and Sharron is even stronger than he guessed, and neither of them was fooled
scenes.text_anchor: This meant that the evil spirit’s malice was stronger than Klein had imagined!

scenes.setting: Chores done, Emlyn denies enjoying them while Utravsky smiles and prays; home to an empty house, he remembers tonight's Sanguine gathering, grumbles about kinsmen who dance like humans, and dresses to attend anyway

A West Borough villa of dancing vampires and vintage blood: Cosmi takes Emlyn down to an iron coffin, where the ancient Nibbs Odora reports a revelation from the Ancestor — the apocalypse nears, Emlyn is one of its key elements — and gives him a task: pray to The Fool
scenes.text_anchor: “Find a chance to pray to The Fool.”
